role: NestJS route guard that validates JWT bearer tokens and populates request.user
detail: Exports AuthGuard (CanActivate implementation) and JwtPayload interface. AuthGuard.canActivate() extracts Bearer token from Authorization header, verifies it against JWT_SECRET from ConfigService, and attaches decoded payload (sub, username, isGuardian) to request.user. Throws UnauthorizedException if header missing, malformed, or token verification fails. No DB/network/FS side effects; purely cryptographic validation.
gotchas: No token expiration check explicit in verify() call — relies on jwt.verify() to reject exp claim if present; no refresh token logic; secret loaded synchronously from config (potential blocking if ConfigService is slow); error catch clause catches all exceptions uniformly without logging or distinction
